newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria arrest 20 suspected bombers - paper.
newsitem.headline: Algeria arrest 20 suspected bombers - paper.

text.p: Algerian security forces have arrested 20 people suspected of involvement in bombings which killed more than a dozen people in an Algerian town during the Moslem month of Ramadan, an Algerian newspaper said on Monday.

El Watan newspaper said three women were among those arrested. Six other suspects were being hunted for the bombings which hit the garrison town of Blida, south of Algiers, in Ramadan which ended early in February.
The newspaper gave no other details on the arrests, announced as the North African country gears up for a parliamentary poll on June 5.
More than 300 people died in massacres and bombings in Algiers and neighbouring towns and hamlets in Ramadan.
Many of the killings were blamed by the authorities on the Moslem fundamentalist Armed Islamic Group (GIA), the most ruthless of Algeria's guerrilla factions.
About 60,000 people have died in Algeria's violence since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
